thread:
maria-support: Hey team — escalated from Acme: when they fan out two tools in parallel (search + summarizer) the tool_result associations sometimes get swapped in the final payload. Happens on ~10% of requests under concurrency. Full repro below.
vik-engr: thanks, can you paste the original request payload and the observed mismatch?
maria-support: pasted minimal repro: 
```json
POST /v1/invoke
{
  "input": "Find latest policy on data retention and summarize for legal",
  "tools": ["search:index_v2", "summarize:legal_v1"],
  "parallel": true,
  "request_id": "acme-2025-08-01-xyz"
}
```
maria-support: Observed response snippet (sensitive fields redacted):
```json
{
  "request_id": "acme-2025-08-01-xyz",
  "tool_results": [
    {"tool": "search:index_v2", "result": "[DOC:policy_123]..."},
    {"tool": "summarize:legal_v1", "result": "Search results: policy_123, policy_456"}
  ]
}
```
maria-support: note the summarize tool appears to have a search-like output. Their expectation: summarizer should return the condensed text, not the doc list.
vik-engr: ugh. do we have correlation_id / call-side IDs? looks like tool_result association lost. any logs with correlation IDs from the runtime?
maria-support: attached runtime logs from their Dedicated cluster, user redacted: 
```
2025-08-01T14:12:03Z INFO route=invoke request_id=acme-2025-08-01-xyz dispatch=[tool-search:call-789, tool-summarize:call-790]
2025-08-01T14:12:03Z DEBUG batcher:dispatch order=[call-790, call-789] kernel=quantized-v2
2025-08-01T14:12:04Z INFO tool-result attach call-789 -> result-id=r-555
2025-08-01T14:12:04Z INFO tool-result attach call-790 -> result-id=r-556
2025-08-01T14:12:04Z WARN result-assembler: mapping mismatch, using arrival order
```
vik-engr: that WARN is the smoking gun. looks like result-assembler falls back to arrival order when correlation metadata missing. sam-ml: could this be due to tool naming collisions in the tool registry (two tools with similar short names)?
sam-ml: possible, or the per-call correlation header (x-rw-call-id) not being propagated into the worker after batching. we introduced a batching optimization that strips non-essential headers in v0.9.7.
jess-sre: which runtime version on Acme Dedicated?
maria-support: they reported runtime 0.9.7+build.32 and custom autoscale policy.
jess-sre: ok we should triage as 0.9.7 regression. can someone reproduce locally with parallel=true and concurrency=12? vik-engr: I'll spin up a small repro in dedicated-sim with 0.9.7 and the same model pair. plan: run 5k requests with random interleaving and assert tool_result.tool matches expected order.
vik-engr: quick note — their logs show dispatch order reversed from call ids, probably batch reorder. if correlation header is present but stripped, assembler will treat results in arrival order.
zach-support: flagged on the customer's ticket and informed about temporary mitigation: set parallel=false or pin to sequential routing until patch. also added billing hold note in ticket until we confirm no data leak.
maria-support: customer asks for an ETA. can we provide a mitigation patch?
sam-ml: probable root cause: header propagation bug in batcher when quantized kernels are used. quick mitigation: re-enable header passthrough for x-rw-call-id and x-rw-tool-name in batcher config. i'll open PR and cherry-pick to 0.9.7-hotfix branch.
vik-engr: repro plan done, confirmed 0.9.7 shows ~7% mismatches when batcher header passthrough disabled. with passthrough enabled, mismatch goes to 0%.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: 0.9.7-hotfix to staging (dedicated-sim) — build 0.9.7-hotfix.1.
jess-sre: once staging looks good, we'll schedule a low-risk rollout to affected Dedicated clusters during off-peak. will coordinate rollback plan.
zach-support: updated the customer: temporary workaround (parallel=false) + we are preparing hotfix; ETA ~24-48h. customer accepted. :thumbsup:
maria-support: thanks all — leaving the rest to eng. saving logs and attaching to ticket.
vik-engr: will follow up with PR link and exact config diff.
sam-ml: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/+/PR-8345 — adds header passthrough toggle and test cases.
vik-engr: closing loop: will create an integration test that fuzzes tool ordering under batching. ticket -> ACME-435.
maria-support: closing thread for now. will reopen if customer sees recurrence.
